newsitem.title: USA: GTECH to service Wisconsin Lottery.
newsitem.headline: GTECH to service Wisconsin Lottery.

text.p: GTECH Holding Corp said on Wednesday it was selected to provide a range of on-line and instant ticket lottery services and equipment to the Wisconsin Lottery.

The Lottery issued a letter of intent to award the contract to GTECH following a competitive process, the company said. GTECH said it expected a five-year contract which could be extended by the lottery for another two years.
The award was subject to the completion of a protest period and the execution of a formal contract.

Under the terms of GTECH's proposal, the lottery's existing central computer system would be replaced with newer GTECH equipment and software, and GTECH's Isys terminals would replace the exisitng on-line lottery terminal base, it said.
GTECH validation terminals would be provided to ticket sellers, the company said.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the potential value of the contract.
